scope: A pre-push hook and a helper script (Bash and Git; the lock needs Linux flock and /proc) for checkouts shared by several coding agents: role-address commits only, no deletion or force-push of the protected branch, an optional scan command, the pushed commit must be the clean HEAD, and the test command runs under one machine-wide file lock. Offline tests with throwaway repositories. No dependencies, fonts or images are bundled. Earlier component approvals do not apply.

source.name: agent-push-guards (extracted from a private repository; the public files were stripped of project-specific names and carry no history)

not_imported: project-specific names, paths and issue numbers

derivations.pre-push: Generalised from a private hook: environment variables renamed to PUSH_GUARD_*, the private scanner call replaced by an optional PUSH_GUARD_SCAN command, the inline personal-address check replaced by the identity helper, organisation wording removed.
derivations.check-identity.sh: Role-address pattern made configurable (PUSH_GUARD_ROLE_PATTERN); organisation wording removed.
derivations.tests/check-identity.test.sh: Fixture addresses replaced by example addresses; the last case checks the new hook text.
derivations.tests/pre-push-head.test.mjs: Renamed variables; the private scanner stub removed.
derivations.tests/pre-push-lock.test.mjs: Renamed variables; the private scanner stub removed.
derivations.tests/pre-push-identity.test.mjs: Rewritten for the identity helper and the optional scan command.
